div.div:
Player1 clicks play , a http call goes to backend and upgrade into a websocket.
Wait for another player to join.
An event(type:waiting) sent from server to client.
If clicks cancel, disconnect the websocket.

div.div:
Player2 clicks play , a http call goes to backend and upgrade into a websocket.
Backend creates a room and shuffle the cards and sent
an event(type:game_start) to both of the players.
Then with a time interval, another event(type:card_reveal) sent to both of the players.

div.div:
If any of the player clicks.
An event(type:click) sent from client to server.
server decides the winner according to logic and send an event(game_over with different result) for winner and loser.
If any of the player get disconnected after game start, server sent and event(type:game_over with result and reason)
